title: A Study of V132 in Healthy Older Participants (V132-001)
official: A Phase 1, Randomized, Double-Blind, Comparator-Controlled Dose-Escalation Study to Evaluate the Safety, Tolerability, and Immunogenicity of V132 in Healthy Older Participants
summary: The goal of this study is to learn about the safety and immune response to the V132 vaccine in healthy older adults.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

The key inclusion criteria include but are not limited to the following:

* Is in good health
* Has body mass index (BMI) within 18.0 to 35.0 kg/m\^2 (inclusive)

Exclusion Criteria:

The key exclusion criteria include but are not limited to the following:

* Has a history of invasive pneumococcal disease or known history of other culture-positive pneumococcal disease within 3 years prior to receiving study vaccination
* Has received a pneumococcal polysaccharide vaccine in the previous 10 years, has received any pneumococcal conjugate vaccine at any time prior to this study
